title: Innocent-counterparty safety scan (synthetic data)
notice: Synthetic ledger. Ground truth was read only by this evaluator, after the engine ran, to classify accounts. No threshold or rule was changed; this measures, it does not tune. Nothing here is a real-world accuracy claim.

ordinary_sample.rule: ground_truth_label 'ordinary', no row in roles.csv, >= 5 transfers; numpy default_rng(seed).choice over the sorted eligible IDs

protected_accounts_flagged.definition: Accounts whose ground truth is innocent_counterparty / lookalike_legitimate (only materialised role) or no materialised scenario role, given potential_intermediary, potentially_suspicious_account, potential_secondary_victim, urgent_manual_review_recommended or consider_temporary_restriction_review, in any position (the investigated account included).

F1_pass_through_exceeds_received.description: Every 'Sent X of the Y it received' / 'Sent X (onward) within 24 h of receiving Y' sentence has X <= Y; forwarded range never exceeds received; ONWARD only with balance-based attribution >= 70%; the engine's capped non-cash onward amount never exceeds received.

F2_cash_withdrawal_counted_twice.description: Independent SQL split of each traced account's onward transfers into non-cash and ATM_CASH_OUT matches the engine; no transfer is in both; money-leaving categories (ONWARD, CASH, FUNDED_FORWARD, FLAGGED_IN_MOVED) count as one kind in evidence strength and the restriction state.

F3_merchant_as_secondary_victim.description: No sme/corporate account, nor any account labelled merchant/employer/cash_network, is labelled potential_secondary_victim or given the savings-based urgent review; savings_left() is never true for one.

F4_receipt_only_restriction_review.description: Every suspicion-side review state (additional verification, urgent review, restriction review; may_be_victim false) has at least one outgoing-side category (ONWARD, CASH, FUNDED_FORWARD, FLAGGED_IN_MOVED, TXN_MODEL); an investigated collection point needs an outgoing signal. Separately reported (not counted as the failure mode): restriction reviews that reach the threshold only because receipt-only NETWORK evidence counts as a kind.
